Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this game and from Super Sunday as well. The action in the ICC Women's T20 World Cup 2023 continues on Monday, the 13th of February with two more games. The first game will be played between Ireland Women and England Women at 6.30 pm IST (1 pm GMT). This will be followed by a clash between South Africa Women and New Zealand Women at 10.30 pm IST (5 pm GMT). Both games will be played at Boland Park in Paarl and you can join us for the early build-up as usual. Cheers!

Chamari Athapaththu, the captain of Sri Lanka Women says that she is feeling good and is happy with the performance. Goes on to aplaud Harshitha Madavi and Nilakshi de Silva for the way they batted. Adds that she just tried to play her natural game and unfortunately she got out early but they have more batting depth and have worked a lot on it in the last few months. Mentions that new coach has brought positive vibes and new strategies are working for them and they are looking forward to make it to the semi-finals. Ends up by saying that they need to improve their bowling a bit more and continue to bat positively and play their natural game.

Bangladesh Women skipper, Nigar Sultana says that they started off well in Powerplay. Adds that they did not get boundaries between 6-15 overs. Mentions that they need to work on boundary scoring and were 15-20 runs short in the batting. Lauds Marufa Akter for her efforts with the ball. Says that they could not stop the Sri Lanka Women batters from getting boundaries and they need to work upon it. Adds that 140 plus would have been good on this wicket. Closes by saying that she is looking forward onto their next game against Australia Women.

Harshitha Madavi (69* off 50 balls) is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. She says her skipper Chamari Athapaththu started off well but after she got dismiseed, she took the responsibility. Adds that it was a bouncy track and she had use her feet to the spinners. Mentions that the SIX she got was a free hit and since it was in her range, she went for it.
The Presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Nigar Sultana opted to bat first on a track that was inconsistent with the bounce and after a blistering start from the top order, the Bangladesh Women innings soon went downhill. Three of the top four batters got to 20 or more runs but then came the squeeze from the Lankan spinner. Oshadi Ranasinghe in particular was brilliant and the skipper, Chamari Athapaththu too had a solid outing with the ball. Sri Lanka Women restricted Bangladesh Women to a low score of 125 runs and after a poor phase of play in which they lost three quick wickets, the Lankans were able to turn things around and get the win.

Bangladesh Women were in the game for a long while but never looked to be on top of proceedings. With not many runs to play with, they didn't have the best of starts with the ball but then came the young Under-19 sensation Marufa Akter into the attack. She picked up three wickets in no time with even a run being scored off her bowling but failed to receive support from the other bowlers. They were a bit sloppy on the field as well and in the end, they simply had no answer to the fine batting display by Harshitha Madavi and Nilakshi de Silva.

Yet another scintillating win for Sri Lanka Women and they have now got off to a perfect start with two wins in a row. Having to chase down a meager total of 126 runs, the openers got off to a pretty good start. But then Chamari Athapaththu fell and the Lankans were all of a sudden three wickets down. Harshitha Madavi though kept continuing to muster up runs and was brilliantly supported by Nilakshi de Silva. The pair put on 104 runs for the fourth wicket with Madavi notching up a half-century as Sri Lanka Women went on to win the game with ease. They have now won back-to-back games in a T20 World Cup for the very first time.

FOUR! Harshitha Madavi does it in style for Sri Lanka Women and roars in joy. Full and outside off. Harshitha Madavi drives it through covers for a boundary. A terrific run chase by Sri Lanka Women as they beat the Bangladesh Women by 7 wickets with 10 balls to spare. Nilakshi de Silva and Harshitha Madavi have added 104 unbeaten runs off 79 balls and have taken Sri Lanka Women home with a win.
Flatter on off stump. Nilakshi de Silva goes back and pulls it to a deep square leg for one.
Full and outside off. Harshitha Madavi drives it to the deep backward point region. A slight misfield allows the batter to take the second.
Good length sliding down the leg. Nilakshi de Silva helps it away to a short fine leg for one.
FOUR! On a length outside off. Nilakshi de Silva reaches out for the cut shot and bottom edges it to the third man region for four.
On a length on the stumps. Harshitha Madavi turns it away to short fine leg for one.
WIDE! Good length angling across and going outside the tramline. Harshitha Madavi reaches out for cut but misses it.
Full again just outside off. Nilakshi de Silva swats it to the deep mid-wicket region for one.
Full and on the off stump line. Nilakshi de Silva whips it to the deep square leg region for a couple.
Fuller on the leg peg. Nilakshi de Silva uses her feet and works it to wide of long on for one.
Flatter and skids past the batter. Nilakshi de Silva looks to run it down but misses.
On a length around off. Harshitha Madavi drops it to the onside and takes a single.
Full and outside off. Nilakshi de Silva sweeps it to a deep square leg for one.
Full and outside off. Nilakshi de Silva lofts it over the infielder toward extra cover for a couple.
FOUR! Full and down the leg. Nilakshi de Silva gets down and sweeps it past the short fine leg for a boundary. Runs are flowing easily for Sri Lanka Women now.
Full and outside off. Almost a yorker. Harshitha Madavi squeezes it to cover. A dot to end the over.
On a length outside off. Nilakshi de Silva pushes it to cover fielder and takes a single.
Length ball on off. Harshitha Madavi tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Full toss around the waist height. Harshitha Madavi helps herself and works it through backward point region for four.
Full and outside off. Harshitha Madavi mistimes the drive back to the bowler.
SIX! BANG! Full and outside off. Harshitha Madavi sits down and clubs it over the deep square-leg fence for a massive hit.

FOUR! DEFT TOUCH! Good length delivery angling outside off. Harshitha Madavi guides this past the short third fielder as the ball races past the rope for four. Harshitha Madavi brings up her FIFTY. Oh No! It's a no-ball too.
DROPPED! Full and outside off. Harshitha Madavi goes for the drive but gets an edge through to the keeper. Shamima Sultana behind the stumps puts it down as the ball ricochets to short third for one.
Short and outside off. Nilakshi de Silva cuts it to the backward point region for one. Marufa Akter puts in the dive and saves it.
Full and outside off. Harshitha Madavi sweeps it to a deep square leg for one.
Full and outside off. Skids on after pitching. Harshitha Madavi looks to work it away but fails to connect.
Full and outside off. Nilakshi de Silva plays with the spin-through covers for one.
Full and outside off. Harshitha Madavi eases this to mid-wicket for one.
Length ball slides on with the arm outside off. Nilakshi de Silva looks to work it on the onside but fails to connect.
Fuller on the stumps. Nilakshi de Silva pushes back at the bowler.
Tossed up outside off. Harshitha Madavi works it to point off the backfoot for a single.
Flatter and outside off. Nilakshi de Silva chops it to a backward point for one.
Very full and down the leg. Harshitha Madavi sweeps it past the short fine leg for a comfortable three. The fielder gives in the chase and saves one.
Drifting into the middle and leg stump line. Nilakshi de Silva tucks it to short mid-wicket and a fumble allows the batter to take one.
On a length around off. Nilakshi de Silva taps it to the onside for a single. FIFTY of the partnership is up between Harshitha Madavi and Nilakshi de Silva.
Length ball on off. Nilakshi de Silva bunts back to the bowler.
Fullish length on the stumps. Harshitha Madavi works it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Harshitha Madavi gets a boundary on this one. Short and wide outside off. Harshitha Madavi slashes hard and carves it through the backward point region for a boundary. Terrific SHOT!

Fuller length outside off. Nilakshi de Silva pushes it to the point and takes off for a run. The point fielder gets a direct hit at the bowler's end as the ball deflects off the stumps and runs away to the long-on fence for four. 5 runs added to Nilakshi de Silva's score.
Full and on the stumps. Nilakshi de Silva flicks it to mid-on.
Full and outside off. Harshitha Madavi drives it to the extra cover region for a couple.
On a length around off. Nilakshi de Silva tucks it to onside and takes a single.
Full and on the middle and leg. Nilakshi de Silva chips it in the vacant mid-wicket region and scampers for a couple.
Fullish on the stumps. Harshitha Madavi flicks it to mid-wicket for one.

On a length around off and middle. Harshitha Madavi gets down to play the ramp shot and misses. Gets hit in the front and the umpires gives it out LBW. Harshitha Madavi reviews it. Nothing on UltraEdge and the wickets are missing on Ball Tracking. Harshitha Madavi survives. NOT OUT is the decision.
FOUR! SMOKED! Full and outside off. Harshitha Madavi gets down on one knee and clubs it to the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Shortish on the middle and leg, pulled away to backward square leg for one.
A slight halt in the play as Harshitha Madavi gets struck on the helmet. The physio is out to perform a mandatory concussion check and everything seems fine. We are good to continue.

Full and outside off. Harshitha Madavi goes for the sweep and misses. The ball is stuck on the helmet of the keeper as it passes through and the ball ricochets to the point region for none. The physio is out in the middle for a mandatory concussion test.
Spins it into the batter. Harshitha Madavi drops it onto the pitch.
FOUR! Gets finer this time. Flatter and quicker outside off. Harshitha Madavi plays it late and guides it past keeper and short third fielder for a boundary.
Shortish and outside off. Harshitha Madavi guides it to short third.
Tossed up outside off. Harshitha Madavi cuts it to the backward point fielder.

Time for Drinks. Sri Lanka Women are struggling here on 49 for 3 at the halfway mark. They need another 78 off 60 balls. Harshitha Madavi has got in and looking good. She needs to bat deep for Sri Lanka Women to have a chance. Marufa Akter has been terrific with the ball for Bangladesh Women taking all 3 wickets to fall so far.
Excellent take from Shamima Sultana behind the sticks. Good length around off, Nilakshi de Silva looks to guide it fine but misses and the ball bounces a bit extra but the keeper pouches it well.
Shorter and angling down leg, this is worked away down to fine leg for a single.

A direct hit but Harshitha Madavi is well in. This is a tad shorter and outside off, Nilakshi de Silva taps it toward point and sets off for the single. The direct hit is scored at the keeper's end but Madavi did well to silde her bat in.
Back of a length outside off, this is punched away straight to cover.
Good length around off ang angling away, Harshitha Madavi stays back and just eases it in front of cover-point for a run.
Starts off with a back-of-a-length delivery outside off. Nilakshi de Silva forces it off the back foot down to long on for a single.
Ritu Moni comes into the attack.
Short and wide, Harshitha Madavi looks to rock back and cut but gets beaten on the outside edge.

A poor review in the end from Bangladesh Women. Nahida Akter tosses it up on a length outside off and turning it in. Harshitha Madavi shuffles across the line of off stump and looks to sweep but misses. There is a loud appeal for lbw and they do eventually review it. Nothing on UltraEDge and Ball Tracking shows that the ball is hitting the pads outside the line of off stump.
Flatter one outside off, this is cut away toward the point region for a quick single.

DROPPED! A difficult chance but Murshida Khatun will feel she should have done better. This is short and wide outside off, Nilakshi de Silva cuts it off the back foot in front of the point where Khatun dives forward but spills the catch. The ball eludes her as well and they get a couple of runs.
Fuller one outside off, Nilakshi de Silva looks to drive but gets an outside edge toward backward point.
Shorter in elngth and around off, Harshitha Madavi pulls it through square leg for a single.
Good length, angling in from outside off, this is blocked out by the batter.
Shorter one on the hips, Harshitha Madavi tucks it to short fine leg for one more.
Back of length around leg stump, flicked down to fine leg for a single.
Full and on leg stump, this is flicked away through mid-wicket for three runs.
Full and around off, driven toward cover.
FOUR! Pitched up around off stump, Harshitha Madavi leans on and drives it straight back past the bowler for a boundary.
Shorter again outside off, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for one.
Slower and shorter outside off, Harshitha Madavi looks to cut but mistimes it badly.
Shorter and on leg stump, this is chipped toward mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up around off, this is pushed away onto the off side for one.
Floated up, on a fullish length and outside off, Nilakshi de Silva opens the face of the bat and guides it to short third man for a single.
Full and around off, Harshitha Madavi shuffles and works it to wide mid on for a single.
Good length outside off, there to be hit. Nilakshi de Silva slashes and misses. Yet another excellent over from the youngster, just 2 runs and a couple of wickets off it.
Back of a length on the body, Nilakshi de Silva nudges it toward short mid-wicket and looks ofr the single but Marufa Akter gets to the ball quickly.

Excellent fielding in the deep! This is full and wide again, Nilakshi de Silva opens the face of the bat and strokes it wide of third man. The fielder there dives full stretch and keeps it down to a couple of runs.
No hat-trick! Fuller in length and angling infrom outside off, Nilakshi de Silva drives it twoard the cover region.
Nilakshi de Silva comes out to bat at number 5.

OUT! TIMBER! Ripper of a delivery from Marufa Akter and she's on a hat-trick! Marufa bowls it a touch fuller and angles it in from outside off. The ball nips back in sharply off the deck and zips past the outside edge of Anushka Sanjeewani's willow as she looks to block. The ball hits the top of off stump and this is just fairytale stuff from Marufa Akter.
Anushka Sanjeewani is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Marufa Akter is having a ball out there! Marufa goes a bit wider of the crease and angles in a length ball into the off stump. The ball sticks a bit on the deck and Vishmi Gunaratne ends up pushing at it. The ball gets chipped off the face of the bat and Marufa takes a simple return catch. Sri Lanka Women lose their second wicket and Marufa has two without even conceding a run.
Flighted delivery around middle, Vishmi Gunaratne plays it with soft hands toward mid-wicket and picks up a single.
An arm ball around off and angling in, Harshitha Madavi gets across and works it in front of mid-wicket for one.
A loopy delivery now, full and around off, Harshitha Madavi pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated up on a nagging length around off, Harshitha Madavi pushes at it and edges it down toward third man for a brace.
FOUR! Nicely done! On the stumps, Harshitha Madavi gets down on one knee and slog-sweeps it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Quicker and flatter around off, pushed away to extra cover.
Wicket-maiden! This is very full and outside the off stump. Vishmi Gunaratne fails to jam it out.
Full and at the stumps, driven toward mid on.
On agood length outside off, Vishmi Gunaratne has a nibble at it but misses.
Vishmi Gunaratne walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Young Marufa Akter gets the big fish! This is bowled fulle and on the off stump. Chamari Athapaththu leans on the back foot and looks to club it across the line. Chamari Athapaththu ends up getting it off the top edge and the ball lobs up around the mid-wicket region. Lata Mondal there takes a good catch and the Under-19 sensation has done the job at the highest level.
Commentary.Howout: c Lata Mondal b Marufa Akter

Commentary.Commentary: Top delivery! Length ball, on a perfect line around off and going across the left-hander. The ball zips past the outside edge as Chamari Athapaththu looks to have a dab at it.
Nicely bowled! Fuller in length and around off, angling across the left-hander. Chamari Athapaththu looks tp push at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Marufa Akter comes into the attack.

Oh, that took off! Jahanara Alam digs one in around the off stump and the ball just takes off after hitting the deck and comes in sharply with the angle as well. Harshitha Madavi does well to get out of the way.
Hardb length and close to the off stump, Harshitha Madavi fends it away toward the gully region.
Pitches it up now on the pads, Chamari Athapaththu works it leg side for a quick single.
Full and around off, Chamari Athapaththu crunches the drive straight to the fielder at cover.
FOUR! Hammered away! Short of a length and outside off, Chamari Athapaththu frees her arms and slaps it away over the point region for a boundary.
This is on a length and puhsed well outside the off stump, Chamari Athapaththu charges down the track and looks to go downtown but misses.
This one is angled into leg stump, Chamari Athapaththu looks to drive but gets an inside edge down to short fine leg for a single.
Flatter one on off stump, Chamari Athapaththu defends it off the front foot.
Flighted one around off, Chamari Athapaththu blocks it out.
FOUR! Lovely stroke! Tosses it up full and outside off, Chamari Athapaththu leans on and crunches the drive past wide long off for another boundary.
FOUR! Just over! Short again outside off, Chamari Athapaththu rocks back and slices it over the leaping fielder at backward point for a boundary.
Starts off with a shortish delivery around the top of off. Chamari Athapaththu goes on the back foot to keep it out.
Salma Khatun to start from the other end.
A tidy first over from Jahanara Alam, just three runs off it. This is full again and angling into the pads, Chamari Athapaththu comes down the track and bunts it down to mid on for a single.
Top delivery! Fuller again around middle and swinging in sharply. Chamari Athapaththu manages to block it out.
Fullish length on the fifth stump line and there's a bit movement in the air as well. Chamari Athapaththu leaves it alone.
Full on off and swinging in late, Chamari Athapaththu walks forward to drive but mistimes it toward mid off.
On a good length in that channel around off, Harshitha Madavi goes hard at it and gets an outside edge down to third man for a single to get off the mark.
WIDE! A length ball on leg stump and swinging down the leg side, Madavi misses the flick and a wide is called. Sri Lanka Women are underway!
Jahanara Alam starts off with a good-length ball from over the wicket and angles it into the pads. Harshitha Madavi tucks it to backward square leg.
